newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tamil Tigers hit air force base in east Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Tamil Tigers hit air force base in east Sri Lanka.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels launched a three-hour attack on an air force base in eastern Trincomalee and damaged one aircraft before being repelled, police said on Thursday.

Police said about 300 Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) attacked the China base with rocket launchers and mortars. Initial reports said one person was killed and several were wounded before the attack was beaten off by military forces at 2.30 a.m. (2130 GMT Wednesday).
